title: Plan gating — trial / basic / advanced
decision: Single entitlements(tenant) derivation + server-side requireFeature/consume guards; Redis counters; charge at enqueue, reconcile at completion; re-check in worker

amended_2026_08_15.change: ALPHA INVERTS THE KEY MODEL. The tiers below assumed the platform pays for scoring on trial/basic (house key), with BYO reserved for advanced. For alpha there is no house key at all: everything is free except model work, and the user's own API key is the ONLY way to score.
consequences: JOBBY-BL-021 (encrypted key custody) becomes launch-blocking rather than an advanced-tier feature — BYO is the only scoring path, so every scoring user hands over a credential on day one
No platform spend to meter in alpha: quotas, billing and the consume() control loop are not needed to launch
Metering becomes measurement — record per-run cost (already captured by /api/run) so paid tiers can be priced from observed numbers instead of guesses
CV editing stays free (deterministic; scripts/cv-export.mjs needs no model). CV chat is model work and sits behind the same gate as scoring.
amended_2026_08_15.tiers_below_apply: post-alpha, once a measured cost per evaluation supports a price

model.rule: UI hiding is UX, never a gate; every gate is server-side at the resource boundary

enforcement.reserve: at /api/run before enqueueRun; refund on failed/cancelled
enforcement.defense_in_depth: worker re-checks entitlement — anything that can write Redis can enqueue
enforcement.error_contract: typed 402/403 { feature, limit, used, upgradeTo } so UI renders an upgrade prompt
enforcement.queue: per-tenant concurrency cap + plan priority so trial cannot starve paid
enforcement.trial_abuse: bind trial to OAuth provider id + verified email; house keys never usable for batch fan-out

fixes: /api/usage currently reads the OPERATOR's ~/.claude/projects (usage/route.ts:17-19) — replace with the tenant's own metered counters

alternatives_rejected.why: not a gate; API remains callable
tenant can enqueue unbounded work before any check
no refund path for failed jobs
